mechanism: Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid and may impair absorption of certain electrolytes; chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia, with pantoprazole further reducing magnesium absorption via acid suppression, increasing hypomagnesemia risk.
action: Monitor serum magnesium and potassium levels regularly; consider magnesium supplementation if levels decline; evaluate necessity of long-term PPI use.
